description: A Node.js script that verifies backend connectivity and API endpoints by performing health checks, authentication endpoint checks, and notes endpoint checks, then summarizes the results.

methods.name: checkHealth
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the health endpoint to verify backend health status.

methods.name: checkAuth
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the auth/login endpoint to verify authentication route accessibility.

methods.name: checkNotes
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the notes endpoint to verify access control.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that runs all checks and outputs a summary, then exits with appropriate status code.
